reviews.text:
I went to Reptile Passion to buy mice, substrate, and accessories for my grass snake, and I can say that the store lives up to its name. Frédéric will be able to advise you perfectly.

I will definitely go back for more purchases.
Thank you for the warm welcome!

Great reptile shop.

This shop was recommended to me for adopting a snake, and it was a very good experience. The salesperson was attentive and gave lots of advice to ensure the animal would be welcomed in the best possible conditions.
I recommend it to anyone who wants to adopt a snake!

A huge thank you to the person (a young man, I think, judging by his voice) who kindly answered my phone call to advise me on the hibernation of a new little Hermann's tortoise (barely bigger than a €2 coin), which we discovered unexpectedly about ten days ago in our garden. A truly pleasant welcome and invaluable information on the next steps... Bravo and congratulations to this kind gentleman for his dedication and professionalism! 🤗

Very welcoming, knowledgeable about his subject, and provides excellent guidance. Very clean and professional, he's not just there to make a sale.
He gives you thorough information and doesn't leave you feeling lost.
We also went to Bébésaurus – avoid them at all costs!

Hello Matthieu
Thank you very much for your ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ rating.
The shop lives up to its name. The owner is a true enthusiast who gives excellent advice and is very friendly. I had a wonderful time in this shop, and I will definitely go back.
This person is available, responsive, and gives good advice. He is very professional and truly loves his job (his passion).
Professionalism and honesty are the watchwords. All our questions find answers in this shop, and that's why we are loyal customers.

A fantastic shop, fantastic animals, and a fantastic person! The owner gives excellent advice and really takes the time to listen to his customers.
Thank you again for your warm welcome and helpful tips!

Not just a simple purchase, but a wonderful experience. Thank you to Fred for selling us our little tortoise.
He's passionate and took the time to guide us through the adoption process.
